issues.title: Byamukama orders immediate sacking of Uganda Airlines finance officer Kyeyune
issues.title_en: Byamukama orders immediate sacking of Uganda Airlines finance officer Kyeyune
issues.summary: The minister of Works and Transport Fred Byamukama has ordered the immediate sacking of Uganda Airlines chief finance officer Allan Kyeyune over lack of requisite qualifications for the job.
